sys.title: Design system
sys.lead: Admin console · F0. Brand, color, typography and, as they land, the components.
sys.statesNote: The dot changes shape with the state — circle, ring, square, dash — because support exports come out in black and white.
sys.forbidden: Forbidden: purple on an organization state or a role. Green on «Active» when the invoice is overdue.
sys.typeNote: Poppins opens the page and the big figures. Instrument Sans does the interface. JetBrains Mono is mandatory on identifiers, quotas, versions and any cell support may paste into a ticket.

sample.body: The organization exceeds 90 % of the contracted storage; the notice was sent to the administrator on September 28.

sys.componentsNote: Height 40 for actions and fields, 48 per table row, radius 8 on controls and 14 on panels. Focus: 1.5 purple-500 border and a 3 px halo. Destructive actions ask you to type the identifier.

c.suspendMessage: All 48 users lose access immediately. Data is kept for 90 days.
c.confirmed: Confirmed: the organization would be suspended.
c.kpi: KPI · figure in Poppins, delta in mono
c.quotaNote: Purple while it counts; amber at 90 % and red at 100 %. Never green: being under quota is not an achievement.
c.ev2: sent the 90 % quota notice to 2 administrators
c.actionRowNote: One concrete thing per row: the dot tells the severity and the whole row leads to where it gets solved.
c.pillsNote: In tables the state has no background: text in its family and a shaped dot. The environment is always spelled out, in mono.
c.navGroupNote: Each menu group opens its submenu; on mobile it is listed under its heading. The group is marked when one of its sections is open and adds up its counts.
c.actionMenuNote: Built on the menu popover. Groups with a separator; destructive goes in red and last. Used by the account and Staff rows.
c.usageNote: Documents used against the limit inside a table: warning tone from 90 % and over tone past the limit; ∞ when there is no cap.
c.tiersNote: Editable list of quantity and discount: checks ascending order and a cap of 10; «Add» proposes double the last quantity.
c.textAreaNote: Text area with a counter when there's a limit; same border and focus as the single-line field.

sys.piecesNote: The organizations table and the record header, with sample data. Mono header, 48 px rows, the selected row in soft purple with its identifier in purple 700; windowed pagination. «Impersonate» is not built: the record opens instead.
